by
  let C := 2 * (Sup (λ τ, ‖f τ‖) (UpperHalfPlane))
  use C
  intro τ
  have : τ ∈ UpperHalfPlane := τ.property
  rw [Sup_le_iff]
  intro ε ε_pos
  obtain ⟨τ₀, hτ₀⟩ : ∃ τ₀ ∈ UpperHalfPlane, ‖f τ₀‖ = Sup (λ τ, ‖f τ‖) (UpperHalfPlane) :=
    @Sup_achieves (λ τ, ‖f τ‖) (UpperHalfPlane) _ _
  obtain ⟨τ₀, hτ₀⟩ := this
  have hτ₀' : τ₀ ∈ UpperHalfPlane := hτ₀
  have hτ₀'' : ‖f τ₀‖ = Sup (λ τ, ‖f τ‖) (UpperHalfPlane) := hτ₀
  have hε : ε < ‖f τ₀‖ := by rw [hτ₀''] at ε_pos; exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_rfl) ε_pos
  have hε' : ε < C := by linext; exact mul_lt_mul_right ε_pos (lt_trans (lt_one (zero_lt_one)) (lt_trans (lt_one (zero_lt_one)) hε))
  exact hε'
